# WO-631: Evidence viewing for the new evidence kinds (friendly labels, no plaintext download)
Status: queued
Vendor: claude
Agent: wizard-packager (Nina Alvarez) then qa-security (Marcus Webb)
Kind: wizard
Tier: deep
Severity: LOW
Owner contact: Morgan Reyes
Target release: 0.5
Source: qa-security review of WO-620 (LOW findings): dashboard.py:418 shows the raw kind "block_capture"; the /evidence route (server.py:349-351) downloads decrypted BLOCK_CAPTURE / HTML evidence as a plaintext file into Downloads.
Boundary: older non-technical users; personal data stays encrypted at rest.

## Task
- Plain-language labels for every EvidenceKind on the dashboard and in the wizard ("What the site showed when it blocked you", "Timeline of your request").
- Show JSON and HTML evidence as escaped text inside the app (sandboxed, no script) instead of downloading a decrypted file. Keep a deliberate "Save a copy" action with a warning that the saved copy is not encrypted.

## Acceptance
- No raw enum value shown anywhere.
- A test shows /evidence never writes a decrypted file without the explicit save action.
- Escaping is tested with a hostile HTML fixture.
